turns.q: Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
turns.replyTail:
o ensure you have a suitable foundation or bed base for your DreamCloud mattress. It works well on most foundations, bed bases (including slatted or divan), or adjustable frames. If you have a slatted base, the maximum distance between slats should be 9cm, and the minimum slat width should be 5cm. Also, please note that DreamCloud is an extremely plush mattress, so make sure your frame can fit a 25cm-29cm mattress. We do not recommend using your DreamCloud on the floor.
